title: ATSC A/85 Long-form Monitor
summary: A practical PLVS monitor for dialogue-led ATSC long-form content.
descriptionMarkdown: This is a monitoring aid, not an A/85 conformance measurement. A/85 calls for dialogue-gated measurement over the complete composite mix using BS.1770-1 without the relative-level gate added by later versions. PLVS instead uses an open voice-activity detector followed by its existing gated Dialogue Integrated calculation. Results therefore depend on detection quality and only evaluate when PLVS has a dialogue estimate. Use a conforming system for delivery certification. ATSC's LKFS values are displayed as numerically equivalent LUFS in PLVS.

references.title: ATSC A/85 Techniques for Establishing and Maintaining Audio Loudness
references.relevanceMarkdown: Defines the long-form dialogue measurement method, target, anticipated measurement variation and True Peak ceiling that this approximate monitor is intended to follow.

references.title: ATSC A/85 Annex M Loudness and True Peak Quick Reference
references.relevanceMarkdown: Summarises the distinction between long-form dialogue loudness and short-form full-program loudness.

releases.notesMarkdown: Initial monitoring release with explicit non-conformance limitations.
